title: Cleaning and Damage Fees Review Standard: Approval Photo Count
content:
**Standard.** For a Cleaning and Damage Fees report under review, the approval photo set is the number of photos the report must have on file before its fee is approved, and it is the minimum photo count of the level held. The photos still needed are the approval photo set less the photos on file, never below zero, counted as a whole number of photos; the driver uploads the photos still needed as one photo submission.

## Inputs

| Input | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| The level held | the fee level on the assessment |
| The minimum photo count of that level | the level's figure for photos on file before review |
| The photos on file | the photo count on the assessment |

## The count

1. The approval photo set is the minimum photo count of the level held.
2. The photos still needed are that set less the photos on file.
3. A result below zero counts as zero: a report that already has as many photos as the set, or more, needs none.
4. The result is a whole number of photos.

## Worked counts (hypothetical reports)

| Minimum photo count of the level held | Photos on file | Photos still needed |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | 1 | 2 |
| 3 | 3 | 0 |
| 3 | 5 | 0 (never below zero) |
| 4 | 0 | 4 |

In the first row the driver's one photo submission carries 2 photos; in the second and third rows there are no photos still needed.
